installer.welcome.title: Install Fresing ToolBox
installer.welcome.text:
Before this screen Windows may have shown “Windows protected your PC”. That is because this installer is not signed yet: Windows does not know Fresing as a publisher. If you downloaded it from github.com/smholte/ToolBox, More info → Run anyway was the right choice.

Fresing ToolBox installs for you only and needs no administrator rights. It starts with Windows and sits next to the clock; you can switch that off in its menu. Uninstall it under Settings → Apps.
